mapper.select: select stage_idx, stage_name, stage_grade, stage_runtime, stage_host, stage_posterName, stage_posterPath, stage_imgInfoName, stage_imgInfoPath, stage_info, theater_idx, ( select theater_name from tcc_theater tt where tt.theater_idx = ts.theater_idx ) as theater_name from tcc_stage ts where stage_idx = #{stage_idx}
mapper.insert: insert into tcc_stage ( stage_idx, stage_name, stage_grade, stage_runtime, stage_host, stage_posterName, stage_posterPath, stage_imgInfoName, stage_imgInfoPath, stage_info, theater_idx ) values ( #{stage_idx}, #{stage_name}, #{stage_grade}, #{stage_runtime}, #{stage_host}, #{stage_posterName}, #{stage_posterPath}, #{stage_imgInfoName}, #{stage_imgInfoPath}, #{stage_info}, #{theater_idx} )
mapper.select: select theater_idx as id, theater_name as name from tcc_theater
